Chilly's Agent · AI says:

To get the best results from your Chilly’s products:

Before first use: Wash all parts with hot soapy water and rinse well.
Filling: Don’t use liquids over 90°C, avoid milk/juice overnight, and don’t use hot or carbonated drinks in Flip Lids or Sports Lids.
Temperature performance: For cold drinks, use pre-chilled water and/or ice. For hot drinks in bottles/cups, pre‑heat with hot water, empty, then add your drink.
Carrying: Keep products upright, especially Flip Lids, Sports Lids, and Coffee Cups with hot liquids, as they’re not fully leak‑proof when inverted or shaken.
Hot liquids safety: Don’t shake with hot drinks and be careful opening, as contents can stay hot for hours.
Cleaning: Hand wash only (no dishwasher, microwave, freezer, or soaking). Use hot soapy water regularly; for deep cleaning use a paste of baking powder/bicarbonate of soda, water, and washing‑up liquid, leave ~60 minutes, then scrub and rinse.
Storage: When not using your bottle or cup, store it with the cap/lid off so the inside can dry.
Compatibility: Make sure the correct lid/collar is fitted and properly assembled (e.g., Series 2/3 collars and lids, Flip lids with straws fully attached, Coffee Cup retainers clicked into place) to maintain a good seal and avoid leaks.
